sections.label: FAQ
sections.title: Everything You Need To Know
sections.subTitle: Quick answers about Safri packages, setup, multi-outlet operations, and restaurant ordering apps.

items.question: What is Safri?
items.answer: Safri is a restaurant technology platform for online ordering, payments, delivery, kitchen apps, and WhatsApp ordering—available as Safri Free, Safri Plus, and Safri 360°.

items.question: How do the plans differ?
items.answer: Safri Free gets one outlet selling online with pickup, curbside, and cash orders. Safri Plus (79 SAR/month) adds online payments, delivery integration, deals, a custom domain, and up to 5 outlets. Safri 360° (250 SAR/month) adds branded Android & iOS apps, a kitchen app, WhatsApp ordering, unlimited outlets, and priority 24×7 support. Paid plans include a 2.5% online payment fee.

items.question: Does Safri support white-label apps?
items.answer: Yes. Each restaurant can ship under its own brand identity while menus, outlets, and orders still run on Safri.

items.question: Which fulfillment types are supported?
items.answer: Safri supports delivery, pickup, dine-in, and curbside flows so guests can order the way your outlets operate.

items.question: Can my staff learn Safri quickly?
items.answer: Yes. Day-to-day workflows—menus, tickets, order status, and outlet settings—are designed for restaurant teams under real service pressure.

items.question: Is Safri available in more than one language?
items.answer: Guest-facing apps support English and Arabic (including RTL), which helps brands serve bilingual markets.

blocks.text: This Privacy Policy explains how Safri (“Safri,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), collects, uses, discloses, stores, and protects personal data when you use the Safri website, applications, marketplace, restaurant-branded ordering channels powered by Safri, merchant dashboards, integrations, customer support, and related services (collectively, the “Services”).
Safri processes personal data in accordance with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (“PDPL”), its Implementing Regulations, and other applicable requirements.

This Policy applies to customers, website visitors, Merchant owners and staff, delivery contacts, prospective customers, and other individuals who interact with Safri. It does not replace the privacy notice of a Merchant, delivery provider, payment provider, or other third party that independently determines how it processes your data.
For processing activities that Safri determines, the controller is:
Safri
Address: Madinah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Privacy email: privacy@safri.food

For some restaurant-specific processing, the relevant Merchant may be an independent controller. For other activities, Safri may act as a processor on the Merchant's documented instructions. If your request concerns a Merchant's independent use of your data, we may direct you to that Merchant or help route your request.
Depending on how you use the Services, we may collect the following categories:

Name, username, customer or Merchant identifier, email address, mobile number, authentication details, billing contact, delivery address, district, city, national address details where provided, and preferred language.

Selected Merchant and branch, ordered items and options, order value, discounts, loyalty activity, payment status, invoice information, delivery or pickup choice, order history, refunds, chargebacks, complaints, and communications concerning an order.

Payment method type, tokenized payment identifier, last digits or similar limited card details supplied by a payment provider, transaction reference, authorization status, and fraud-screening result. Complete card details are ordinarily collected and processed directly by licensed payment providers rather than stored by Safri.

Delivery address, map pin, approximate or precise device location when you enable location permission, delivery instructions, and delivery status. You may deny device-location permission and enter an address manually, although some location-based features may then be unavailable.

Business and branch details, commercial and tax information, owner or authorized representative details, staff names and roles, work contact information, account permissions, plan and billing information, device pairing, and operational activity within the dashboard.

IP address, device and browser type, operating system, app version, identifiers, language, time zone, login and security events, crash information, referring page, pages and features used, clicks, session duration, and cookie or similar technology data.
Messages, call or chat details, form submissions, survey responses, complaints, support history, photographs or documents you choose to provide, and records of consent or communication preferences.
Reviews, ratings, saved addresses, favourite Merchants or items, dietary selections, promotion and loyalty preferences, and other content submitted through the Services.

Please avoid entering sensitive personal data in free-text fields unless it is necessary for your request. Dietary information may in some circumstances reveal health or religious information and will be handled in accordance with applicable requirements.
We collect personal data:
Directly from you, when you create an account, place an order, subscribe, contact support, complete a form, enable a device permission, or otherwise use the Services.
From Merchants, when a restaurant creates staff access, processes an order, updates fulfilment, responds to a complaint, or provides business contact information.

From service providers and integrations, such as payment providers, delivery companies, identity or fraud-prevention tools, communications services, point-of-sale integrations, and analytics providers.
Automatically, through logs, cookies, SDKs, pixels, and similar technologies when you use our website or applications.
From public or authorized sources, such as a Merchant's publicly available business details or information supplied by its authorized representative.

Where providing data is mandatory, we will indicate this at collection. If you do not provide information required to create an account, fulfil an order, process payment, deliver products, provide a requested feature, or comply with law, we may be unable to provide the relevant Service.

chapters.heading: 5. Why we process personal data and our legal bases

blocks.text: We process personal data only for a clear purpose and an applicable legal basis, including the following:

rows: Create, authenticate, and manage accounts
Identity, contact, authentication, Merchant staff data
Performing a contract or taking requested pre-contract steps; legitimate interests where permitted
Receive, route, prepare, deliver, collect, or refund orders
Contact, order, transaction, address, location, payment status
Performing the customer or Merchant contract; providing a requested service
Process subscriptions, payments, settlements, invoices, refunds, and chargebacks
Business, billing, payment, and transaction data
Performing a contract; compliance with legal obligations
Provide customer and Merchant support
Identity, order, communications, attachments
Performing a contract; legitimate interests in resolving issues and improving service
Operate loyalty, coupons, rewards, and promotions
Account, order history, preferences, loyalty activity
Performing program terms; consent where required
Send direct marketing
Contact details, preferences, campaign interactions
Consent or another lawful basis permitted for the specific communication; you may opt out at any time
Secure the Services and prevent fraud or misuse
Account, transaction, device, log, and security data
Compliance with legal obligations; legitimate interests in protecting users and the Services
Monitor performance, troubleshoot, analyze, and improve the Services
Usage, device, crash, support, and aggregated data
Legitimate interests where permitted; consent for non-essential cookies or technologies where required
Comply with law, audits, regulatory requests, and legal claims
Relevant account, transaction, communication, and business data
Compliance with legal obligations; establishment, exercise, or defence of legal claims
Enable integrations selected by a Merchant or customer
Account, order, delivery, payment, and business data as necessary
Performing a contract; consent where required

blocks.text: Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw it at any time using the relevant settings, unsubscribe method, device permission, or the contact details below. Withdrawal does not affect processing that was lawful before withdrawal.
Where we rely on a legitimate interest, we assess the need for the processing and its impact on your rights and do not rely on that basis where your rights or interests override it.
We disclose only the data reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose and may share it with:

The Merchant and relevant branch to accept, prepare, fulfil, support, and refund your order. This may include your name, telephone number, order details, address, delivery instructions, and payment status.
Delivery providers and drivers to arrange, complete, communicate about, and track delivery.
Payment, banking, wallet, and fraud-prevention providers to authorize payments, process settlements and refunds, prevent fraud, and handle disputes.

Technology service providers supporting cloud hosting, security, communications, notifications, analytics, customer support, mapping, and system integrations under appropriate contractual and security controls.
Professional advisers, auditors, insurers, and financiers where reasonably necessary and subject to appropriate confidentiality obligations.
Government, judicial, regulatory, or law-enforcement authorities where disclosure is required or permitted by applicable law.

A purchaser, investor, successor, or transaction adviser in connection with a proposed or completed merger, financing, reorganization, or transfer of all or part of the business, subject to applicable law and appropriate safeguards.
Other parties at your direction or with your consent.
Safri does not sell or rent personal data to third parties for their independent direct marketing.

When you order through a Merchant's Safri-powered website or application, both Safri and that Merchant may receive your personal data. The Merchant independently controls matters such as its menu, order fulfilment, customer service, legally permitted customer relationship, and any marketing for which it is responsible.

Merchants must use Safri-provided customer data in accordance with their agreements, the PDPL, and other applicable law. You should also review the relevant Merchant's privacy notice. Safri is not responsible for processing that a Merchant conducts outside Safri's instructions or Services, except to the extent liability cannot lawfully be excluded.

Some approved service providers may process or support personal data from locations outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Where personal data is transferred or disclosed outside the Kingdom, Safri will take the steps required by the PDPL and the applicable regulation on personal data transfers, including limiting the transfer to what is necessary and using an approved legal mechanism or appropriate safeguards where required.
You may contact privacy@safri.food for information about the safeguards applicable to a relevant transfer, subject to confidentiality and security restrictions.
Safri and authorized providers may use cookies, SDKs, pixels, local storage, and similar technologies for:

items: essential authentication, security, cart, checkout, language, and session functions;
saving preferences and improving convenience;
measuring traffic, performance, and feature usage;
diagnosing errors and preventing fraud; and
advertising or campaign measurement where you have provided any required consent.

blocks.text: You can manage non-essential technologies through any cookie or privacy settings made available within the Services and through your browser or device settings. Blocking essential technologies may prevent parts of the Services from working correctly. Safri will request consent for non-essential cookies or similar technologies where required.

Safri may send promotional email, SMS, push notification, or other direct marketing only on an applicable legal basis. You may opt out using the unsubscribe link, account or notification settings, or by contacting us.
Opting out of marketing does not prevent necessary transactional messages about your account, security, orders, payments, subscriptions, or support requests.
Merchants are independently responsible for their own marketing activities and consents where they determine the campaign.
Safri retains personal data only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected and processed. The criteria used to determine the period include:

items: the duration of your account, order, Merchant subscription, or other relationship with Safri;
the time needed to fulfil orders, provide support, administer loyalty, and complete settlements or refunds;
applicable tax, accounting, e-commerce, payment, data-protection, and recordkeeping requirements;
limitation periods and the need to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims;
fraud-prevention, cybersecurity, audit, and service-integrity needs; and
a valid request for destruction and whether a legal exception requires continued retention.

blocks.text: When personal data is no longer required, Safri will securely destroy it or anonymize it so that it can no longer identify you. Backup copies may remain for a limited period until overwritten or securely destroyed, subject to applicable requirements.
Consent records may be kept as necessary to demonstrate compliance, and data needed to honour a marketing opt-out may be retained in a suppression list.

Safri uses appropriate organizational, administrative, and technical measures designed to protect personal data against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, misuse, or destruction. These measures may include access controls, encryption in transit and where appropriate at rest, logging, backups, vendor due diligence, vulnerability management, and staff confidentiality controls.

No system is completely secure. You are responsible for protecting your credentials and notifying Safri promptly of suspected unauthorized access. If a personal data breach requires notification, Safri will notify the competent authority and affected individuals in accordance with applicable law.
Subject to the PDPL and its applicable exceptions, you may have the right to:
Be informed about the legal basis and purpose of collecting your personal data and how it is processed.
Access your personal data held by Safri.
Request a copy of your personal data in a readable and clear format.
Request correction, completion, or updating of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
Request destruction of personal data when the applicable legal conditions are satisfied.
Withdraw consent at any time where consent is the basis for processing.

You may exercise your rights through available account settings or by contacting privacy@safri.food. Please describe your request and the Safri account, order, or Merchant relationship concerned. We may verify your identity and authority before responding to protect personal data from unauthorized disclosure.

We will respond within the period required by applicable law. A request may be restricted or refused only where permitted by law, and we will provide the required explanation. There is ordinarily no charge, but applicable law may permit a reasonable charge or refusal for manifestly unfounded or excessive repeated requests.
If the processing is controlled independently by a Merchant or third party, we may direct you to the appropriate entity.
If you have a privacy concern, please contact privacy@safri.food first so we can investigate and respond.

You also have the right to submit a complaint to the competent data-protection authority in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through the official channels made available by the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA), subject to the applicable complaint requirements and time limits.

Safri's account and Merchant Services are not directed to children. Merchant accounts may be managed only by adults. A person under 18 should use customer ordering features only with the permission and supervision of a parent or legal guardian.

If we become aware that a child's personal data was collected without the authority required by applicable law, we will take appropriate steps to restrict or destroy it. A parent or guardian may contact privacy@safri.food.

Safri may use automated tools to help detect fraud, recommend content, rank search results, personalize the experience, or route orders. Safri does not intend to make a decision based solely on automated processing that produces legal or similarly significant effects on an individual without providing the notices, safeguards, and rights required by applicable law.

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in law, technology, the Services, or our processing practices. We will post the updated version and revise the “Last updated” date. If a change materially affects your rights or how we process personal data, we will provide additional notice or obtain consent where required.
